commands:
cat > .git/hooks/pre-commit << 'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
# Pre-commit hook to run mypy type checking on Python files in src/

echo "Running mypy type checking..."

# Run mypy on all Python files in src/
mypy src/

# Check exit status
if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "#"
    echo "# Type checking failed!"
    echo "# Please fix the type errors before committing."
    echo "#"
    exit 1
fi

echo "Type checking passed!"
exit 0
EOF
